summary: Backend-only verification of newly merged auth/security features (DELETE /api/auth/account, admin-gated /api/admin/stats, login rate limiter, registration is_admin default, demo_user login). All 10 pytest cases passed against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1700 lines and should be split into modules (auth, admin, properties, etc.) per code review guidelines (>700 line threshold).
LoginRateLimiter is in-memory only; documented in code, but under multi-replica deploy it will not enforce globally. Consider Redis-backed limiter before horizontal scaling.

delete_account cascades across ~15 collections but does NOT delete: community_posts / community_comments / post_likes / amenity_bookings / complaints / documents (uploaded_by) / meetings / meeting_rsvps / hoa_charges / payment_transactions / visitors / pending_user_approvals authored by the user. If GDPR-style full erasure is intended, extend the cascade. (server.py:1339-1360)
delete_account allows self-deletion by super_admin/hoa_admin without transferring managed_properties ownership -- may orphan communities. Consider a guard.
get_current_admin_user grants access when EITHER is_admin OR is_super_admin is true; documented and works. Good that DB is checked (not JWT claim).
seed_data_creation: Tests create throwaway TEST_* users via /api/auth/register and clean them up via DELETE /api/auth/account. One super-admin promotion is done via pymongo directly, then the user is deleted. demo_user was NOT modified/deleted. Rate-limit burst uses X-Forwarded-For with a unique spoofed IP + a unique throwaway username so it does not lock out demo_user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_security.py. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auth_security.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. BASE_URL is loaded from /app/frontend/.env (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Rate-limit test uses spoofed X-Forwarded-For + unique throwaway username so it will not interfere with demo_user or other tests. Tests are idempotent -- all created users are deleted before completion.
verified_behaviors: POST /api/auth/register -> new user has is_admin=false (proved via 403 on /api/admin/stats)
GET /api/admin/stats after `manage_admin.py grant` -> 200 with stats payload {total_users,total_assets,assets_by_category,users}
DELETE /api/auth/account correct password -> 200 message; subsequent login for that username -> 401
POST /api/auth/login burst of 45 wrong-password attempts (same spoofed IP + username) -> 429 'Too many attempts' triggered before 45th attempt (limit 30/300s)
